name: Citizenship by Descent or Birth in Territory

requirement_groups.name: Child of a Kyrgyz citizen parent

requirements.blocker_text: Citizenship Law of the Kyrgyz Republic (2007, as amended through 2023), Article 12(1): a child whose parent(s) were Kyrgyz citizens at the time of birth is a Kyrgyz citizen regardless of place of birth. Article 12(2): a single Kyrgyz-citizen parent is sufficient, unless both parents jointly renounce it when the child acquires a foreign citizenship at birth. Explicitly gender-neutral -- no distinction between maternal and paternal transmission.
requirements.fix_path: Establish a parental link to a Kyrgyz citizen (either parent) via a birth certificate.

requirement_groups.name: Born in Kyrgyzstan to stateless or unknown parents

requirements.blocker_text: Article 12(4): a child born in Kyrgyz territory to stateless parents acquires citizenship. Article 12(5): a child born domestically to two foreign-national parents becomes a citizen if neither parent's state grants the child citizenship. Article 12(6): a child found in Kyrgyz territory whose parents are both unknown is a citizen.
requirements.fix_path: Establish birth in Kyrgyzstan to stateless parents, to two foreign parents whose states would not grant the child citizenship, or as a foundling with both parents unknown.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate showing parental link or place of birth
Proof of parents' statelessness or foreign nationality (birth-in-territory route only)

sources.title: Refworld -- Law of the Kyrgyz Republic on Citizenship (2007, amended through 22 February 2023): descent (Art. 12(1)-(2)), birth-in-territory/statelessness (Art. 12(4)-(6)), dual citizenship rules (Art. 6, 22)
